name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Ebola emergency of international concern remains in force; no new PHEIC found in the past 30 days
state: The Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic, declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May, continues: WHO counted cases in five countries by 20 Oct (WHO), and ECDC's 19 Nov update reports community transmission ongoing in DR Congo (ECDC). Searches to 22 Nov found no new PHEIC in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so a PHEIC in effect keeps Watch.
for_you: Follow WHO, UKHSA and FCDO travel health advice if travelling to DR Congo or neighbouring countries.

why: A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) or 'pandemic emergency' is the top official global health alarm.
drivers: Outbreak spread, IHR Emergency Committee decisions.

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
